import os
import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split
from sklearn.metrics import roc_auc_score
import xgboost as xgb

# Load data
train = pd.read_csv("./input/train.csv")
test = pd.read_csv("./input/test.csv")
sample_submission = pd.read_csv("./input/sample_submission.csv")

print(f"Train shape: {train.shape}")
print(f"Test shape: {test.shape}")

# Feature engineering - character level n-grams are often better than word level
train["comment_len"] = train["comment_text"].apply(len)
train["num_chars"] = train["comment_text"].str.len()
train["has_numbers"] = train["comment_text"].str.contains(r"\d+")

# Create feature matrix
X_train_full = train[["comment_len", "num_chars", "has_numbers", "comment_text"]].values
y_train = train[
    ["identity_hate", "insult", "obscene", "severe_toxic", "threat", "toxic"]
].values.astype(int)

# Split for validation (use 20% holdout for final scoring, never touch this in training)
X_val, X_train_data, y_val, y_train_only = train_test_split(
    X_train_full, y_train, test_size=0.2, random_state=42, shuffle=False
)

# Train XGBoost model for each target separately
models = {}
for col_idx in range(y_train.shape[1]):
    # Use simpler parameters for initial run
    model = xgb.XGBClassifier(
        objective="binary:logistic",
        max_depth=4,
        learning_rate=0.05,
        n_estimators=200,
        seed=42,
        n_jobs=-1,
    )
    model.fit(X_train_data, y_train_only[:, col_idx])
    models[col_idx] = model

# Validation score (should not count toward final submission if done after model selection)
val_scores = []
pred_prob_for_val = np.zeros((len(X_val), 6))
for idx, model in models.items():
    val_pred = model.predict_proba(X_val)[:, 1]
    pred_prob_for_val[:, idx] = val_pred
    val_scores.append(roc_auc_score(y_val[:, idx], val_pred))

mean_roc_auc_val = np.mean(val_scores)
print(f"Validation Mean ROC AUC: {mean_roc_auc_val:.6f}")

# Get test predictions
preds_test_probs = []
test_ids = test["id"].tolist()
test_data = test[["comment_text"]].values
for idx, model in models.items():
    pred_prob = model.predict_proba(test_data)[:, 1]
    preds_test_probs.append(pred_prob)

# Create submission
submission_df = sample_submission.copy()
submission_df.iloc[: len(preds_test_probs), 1:] = np.array(preds_test_probs).T
submission_df.to_csv("./submission/submission.csv", index=False)

# Calculate and print evaluation metric on validation set
mean_roc_auc = np.mean(val_scores)
print(f"{mean_roc_auc:.6f}")
